title: LogoTool provisional customer project
description: PROVISIONAL draft (schemaVersion 0.1.0-provisional). Customer project embedding product/logo snapshots plus configurations, confirmation and review state. Every content mutation creates a new revision (integer counter + digest of the canonical configuration); content change invalidates the current confirmation (prior confirmations kept in history). Opening or importing never confers approval. Draft status: subject to the Phase 1 Odoo-discovery exit gate; do not treat as final. Synthetic fixture data only.

schemaVersion.description: Provisional schema version literal. Any other or missing value must be rejected with a version error.

synthetic.description: Fixture marker. Synthetic example data only; never real customer data.

revision.description: Content revision counter. Every content mutation yields a new revision.

products.description: Embedded product definition snapshots (baseline for tamper checks).

confirmation.description: Customer confirmation binding { revision, digest, confirmedBy, confirmedAt }. Absent means unconfirmed (draft).

review.description: Current internal review state, separate from customer confirmation. Never conferred by opening, validating, or importing.

history.description: Superseded prior confirmations (invalidated by later content changes).

issuedBaselineHash.description: Optional hash of the issued baseline for identity checks.

method.description: Production method. Must be listed in the region allowedMethods.

rotationDeg.description: Clockwise-positive facing the region, normalized to (-180,180]. JSON cannot represent NaN/Infinity; core additionally enforces Number.isFinite on every numeric field.

placement.description: Placement: pos (xMm,yMm) is the artwork bbox center in the region frame (mm, +x right, +y up facing the region); widthMm/heightMm is the axis-aligned bbox BEFORE rotation (finite, > 0).

digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex of the canonical operational content envelope bytes (schemaVersion, projectId, products, logos, configurations, instructions — never revision/confirmation/review bookkeeping). confirmedBy is customer-supplied evidence text, never authenticated identity.

decision.description: Internal approval state. Customer confirmation never equals internal approval.
